log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 0 gate (task 0.8)

body.p: Questions the review left open, for the owner or a later phase. None blocks Phase 1.

item.p: Thread-local scope for libmpdec (). It keeps heaps independent and leaves no state between calls, but it is the one thread-local in sxml. Accept it, or require the own-decimal fallback?
Phase 0 time box (). Recorded by the review agent because the original was never written; the owner may want another length.

Typed values (from 0.7). Kept as one optional get_typed_value operation in sxml_tree_operations. Phase 5 publishes a separate schema interface only if validated trees need more than typed values and the is_id/is_idrefs/is_nilled flags; "interfaces are not extended in place" applies.
Inline decimals (from 0.7). Not added: integers that fit int64_t are inline already (); a scaled-integer fast path for short decimals can be a later cell format without an interface change.
Sharing one parsed document between threads (). Still deferred; the likely shape is an immortal, frozen tree with a read-only name pool.
Error record lifetime for host bindings (from 0.5). Kept as borrowed views (, ); bindings copy what they keep.

Strings without a copy. sxml_atomic_item_make copies text, so fn:substring and string concatenation cannot share or adopt a buffer. If profiling in Phase 2 shows the cost, add a constructor that adopts a heap buffer, with a decision record (the substrate is frozen at the Phase 1 gate).
Schema-derived atomic types (Phase 5). The registry has no function to register them yet; it will be a new function, with a record.
Document and collection resolution (). Designed with the dynamic context in Phase 1, outside the substrate headers.
